tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: What 3Descu can manufacture: technologies, build volumes, layer heights, accepted file formats, production tiers, minimum order value, and what is available on request. Call this first if you do not know whether a part is feasible.

tools.name: list_materials
tools.description: The materials available for FDM and SLA printing, with density and what each is suited to. Returns the id that estimate_price expects.

tools.name: analyze_model
tools.description: Download a 3D model from a public https URL and measure it: volume, bounding box, surface area, triangle count, and whether the mesh is watertight. Accepts .stl and .obj. Feed surface_area_mm2 from the result into estimate_price to get an exact price instead of a range. Only well-known model-hosting

tools.name: estimate_price
tools.description: Price a part in EUR across economy, standard and express production, using the same engine as the public calculator. Supply surface_area_mm2 for a single price; omit it and the answer is the range the shape could produce. Excludes shipping and VAT.
